model.title: INSULIN Act of 2026
model.meta: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee · Sen. Jeanne Shaheen (D-NH)

summary.text: The bill would seek to reduce insulin prices for patients and establish protections to limit how much people pay out of pocket for the medication. It aims to make insulin more affordable and accessible by addressing the high costs that have burdened many Americans who depend on this essential diabetes treatment.
